claim_being_audited: That the model can be certified for launch now because aggregate readiness passes, rehearsal had no severity-one incidents, and the remaining fraud dispute review gap can be handled through documentation and monitoring rather than treated as a launch blocker.
decision_criteria: A weakness is material if it affects a contractual customer segment or named launch use case.
Product labels such as non-core or low-volume do not resolve materiality when the segment is named in customer commitments.
For material limitations in named launch use cases, the policy requires resolution, disclosure, or approved risk acceptance before launch.
Public governance principles can support monitoring and documentation, but they do not override the internal release-policy predicate.
evidence_requests: Provide the final legal determination on whether the fraud dispute review gap must be disclosed for launch.
Provide the actual launch disclosure or model-card language covering this material limitation, if completed.
Provide an approved risk-acceptance record that explicitly covers this gap before launch.
Provide evidence that the two bank pilot commitments were amended, waived, or are not launch-relevant named use cases.
specific_concerns: The fraud dispute review segment misses target by 1.3 percentage points.
That segment is named in two bank pilot commitments, which makes the weakness material under the stated policy.
The product note calling the segment non-core because it is 7% of projected traffic does not resolve materiality for a named committed segment.
Legal review on whether the gap must be disclosed is still open.
The release-policy note requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
The admissible record contains no completed legal determination, no evidence of disclosure, and no approved risk acceptance.
unsupported_claims: That aggregate readiness and lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents are sufficient to certify despite an unresolved material limitation in a named committed segment.
That public model-card guidance and public AI risk-management guidance justify launch absent satisfaction of the internal disclosure-or-risk-acceptance requirement.

That the remaining risk can be managed through documentation and monitoring rather than being a launch blocker, because there is no admissible evidence that the required disclosure path or approved risk acceptance has been completed.
